info.bio:
Andrew Weatherall's Sabres of Paradise were one of the U.K.'s most celebrated experimental techno groups. A combined effort of Weatherall and collaborators Jagz Kooner and Gary Burns, the group released a flood of singles and EPs, many of which were collected on compilations released by Warp and Weatherall's other main focus: the Sabrettes label, with releases from Plod and Slab, among others. 

Weatherall, considers himself a DJ first, and his exhausting schedule of deckwork has been arguably as influential as his records

scenes.name: Ambient house e IDM
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Música para relajarse en las «chill-out rooms» que se convierte en género propio, entre el techno y el minimalismo: Chill Out de KLF es su manifiesto; Irresistible Force, Orb (Adventures Beyond The Ultraworld, U.F. Orb: el DJ convertido en compositor clásico), Ultramarine, Global Communication, Spacetime Continuum, Banco De Gaia, Woob. La «Intelligent Dance Music»: Orbital (Brown Album), Eat Static, Sabres Of Paradise, Future Sound Of London, Black Dog, Leftfield, Richard James / Aphex Twin, Plastikman, Moby, Vapourspace. Y la música de baile para no bailarines: Scanner, Faithless, Lo-Fidelity Allstars, Luke Slater, Christian Vogel, David Holmes, Susumu Yokota.

scenes.book: Loops 1 y 2. Una historia de la música electrónica
scenes.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
scenes.desc: Etiqueta europea alejada del tenebrismo de Scorn y cercana a lo más pulsante de The Orb («Blue Room», cuarenta minutos). Bobby Bird le da nombre desde su sello Beyond y The Higher Intelligence Agency; Andrew Weatherall le da sentido con The Sabres of Paradise: Sabresonic y Haunted Dancehall, «si fuese una película, sería Blade Runner».

podcast.title: Ongoing Re-edition Project
podcast.body: The band has been re-editing almost all of their material over the past few years, though some items were still missing until this new release. "hace unos años es redito, casi todos los haybre skill pero faltan algunas cosas."
